title: ProductSatisfaction
description: ISO 25010-sourced quality archetype — Satisfaction quality-in-use characteristic. Measures the degree to which user needs are satisfied when a product is used in a specified context. Sub-characteristics: Usefulness, Trust, Pleasure, Comfort. Rootless archetype — used as qualifier in Directives/Norms. Source: ISO/IEC 25010 (Quality in Use — Satisfaction).

usefulnessRating.description: User-perceived usefulness — degree to which the product achieves pragmatic goals including results and consequences of use.

trustLevel.description: Degree to which users have confidence that the product behaves as intended.

pleasureRating.description: Degree of pleasure derived from fulfilling personal needs (stimulation, identification, evocation).

comfortRating.description: Degree of physical comfort during product use.
